subject: seahorse
pitch: A lined seahorse holding on to a strand of seagrass with its curled tail. A ridged body in sunny yellow with thin dark lines and a few white freckles, a little crown of spikes on its head, a long tube snout, a delicate fluttering fin on its back, and big, curious eyes.

Placing the eyes on the sides of the head with the pupils offset slightly outward so they bulge like a seahorse's, then adding small spikes along the top of the head to form a crown, keeping their color pale to contrast gently rather than going bold orange.
